import numpy as np
import os
from PIL import Image
_p = 'branding/host_jose.png'
if not os.path.exists(_p):
    _p = '/home/jose/tiktok/branding/host_jose.png'
f = np.asarray(Image.open(_p).convert('RGB')).mean(axis=2)
gris = f[300:900, 200:600]
chico = gris[::8, ::8]
cortes = np.percentile(chico, [40, 75])
clases = np.digitize(chico, cortes)
grande = np.kron(clases, np.ones((8, 8), dtype=int))
fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(9.8, 4.4))

axs[1].imshow(chico, cmap='gray'); axs[1].set_title('baja resolución', fontsize=20)
axs[2].imshow(grande, cmap='viridis'); axs[2].set_title('una clase por píxel', fontsize=20)
